toc.title: Domino et affini chariss. Henrico Corputio, Ecclesiastæ Dordracensi pio & fideli, Franciscus Iunius S.
In epistolam S. Iudae Apostoli perbreves notae, ex prælestionibus Francisci Iunij Biturigis.

book: Francis Junius's 1584 Antwerp edition of brief notes on the Epistle of Jude: a title page, a dedicatory letter to Henricus Corputius, the work's heading with its introduction (five numbered heads), and the commentary on the epistle's single chapter, headed Cap. 1.
